scope: Exact homogeneous tensor ODE for one visco-morphoelastic Kelvin–Voigt model. weak_limit_note: The paper's vanishing-diffusion weak limit may contain a Jaumann commutator defect; strong convergence of F in L-infinity L2 or of grad(v) in L2 is sufficient for its disappearance.
